slides.prompt: What evidence habit do we reuse today?
slides.hint: Monday: 4 checks to find the missing link.
slides.notes: 60-min Tue lesson, sl_t1. Monday one-liner only, no reteaching. Outcomes (teacher-kept): read the p.69 passage clearly for PBD; use 6 new words in own sentences.

slides.prompt: Before we open the book — what changed?
items: Life was disrupted, but cooperation grew.
slides.notes: Prime Module p.69 ideas. Partner talk 1 min: which change still helps us today? Point and say why.

slides.prompt: What do these three words mean?
slides.answer: Resilient means strong again after difficulty. Severity means how serious an illness is. Droplet means a very tiny drop.
slides.notes: Elicit meanings before revealing. -let spotlight: drop + -let, book + -let, leaf + -let.

slides.prompt: What do the next three words mean?
slides.answer: Vital means very important. Disruption means stopping normal life. Significant means very great or very large.
slides.feedback: Use each word in a new sentence, not its definition.
slides.notes: Module gloss for significant follows p.69. Misconception: pupils copy definitions — enforce show, don't repeat.

columns.label: Strong version
columns.text: Vaccines reduced the severity of illness so fewer people became very sick.

slides.hint: Look for an action and a result.
slides.notes: Frame: word + action + detail + because/so + result. Copy the habit, not the sentence.

items: Open Module p.69. Eight readers read one paragraph each.
Listeners raise hands on their team's word.
slides.notes: Passage stays in the book — slides only prime (book copyright). Evidence: fluency + one heard-word per listener. Record 8 readers separately; no names in artifacts.

slides.task: Choose one of the six words. Write one strong sentence about your life or school that shows its meaning.
slides.frame: Word + action + detail + because / so + result.
slides.notes: 5 min silent exit. Bridge: Thursday turns the p.70 handwashing essay into an information-transfer table. Collect short/long books after.
